summary: Static frontend-only CareFlex site tested end-to-end. All pages render without backend calls, FormSubmit AJAX wiring verified for contact + footer forms (both 200 OK, success UIs shown), cart flow + CARE10 promo works, language toggle works, /admin route renders empty (no dashboard), no 'Staff Login' in footer, zip download at /careflex-static-site.zip returns HTTP 200 application/zip (~649KB). No backend /api requests were made from any page (only external Google Maps + FormSubmit).
verified_flows: Home: hero-title + 3 category tiles (diabetes-care/mobility-aids/orthotics) + quick-shop-grid with 12 items + testimonials
/product/standard-wheelchair: renders, has data-testid 'coverage-badge-insurance' (note: task referred to 'insurance-badge' but actual is coverage-badge-insurance — same purpose)
/cart: item shows, promo CARE10 -> discount −$3.50, total $31.49 (10% of $34.99)
/faq: 8 questions + JSON-LD script present (2 ld+json scripts on page)
Contact form POST -> https://formsubmit.co/ajax/contact@careflexsupplies.com HTTP 200 -> contact-success shown + toast
Footer mini-form POST -> formsubmit.co HTTP 200 -> footer-form-success shown
/admin route renders blank (no admin dashboard or login) — clean removal
Zero requests to REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /api/* from any page (only Google Maps + FormSubmit external calls observed)
notes: FormSubmit returned HTTP 200 with normal success JSON for both submissions (activation appears complete OR endpoint accepts and queues — either way UI handled gracefully and both success states rendered).
Task referenced testid 'insurance-badge' on product detail; actual is 'coverage-badge-insurance'. Functional equivalent — not a bug, just naming.
Only 2 form submissions made (contact + footer) to avoid spamming as instructed.
critical_code_review_comments: Clean, focused static implementation. api.js exports only FormSubmit helper — no axios, no backend URL usage anywhere in pages.
content.js retains legacy UUID 'id' fields from previous backend seeding; harmless but could be dropped for smaller bundle.
MiniContactForm is defined in Layout.jsx — consider extracting so Layout.jsx stays small (currently ~320 lines, still acceptable).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fully static site — no backend. FormSubmit target is contact@careflexsupplies.com. Real emails may be sent on submission; keep submissions to 2-3 max with TEST_ prefixes. Zip served from Express static at /careflex-static-site.zip.
